{{Event infobox | location = Lost Basilica | type = group event | indicator = collect | level = 80 | meta event = The Basilica Vaults | success = Gather the loose magic for Isgarren | coordinates = [6875.0, 57811.5] | requires = voe }} [[Defeat the ancient defenses and gather their power for Isgarren]] is the first part of [[The Basilica Vaults]] [[meta event]]. The event takes place inside the [[Lost Basilica]], which is inaccessible outside of the meta event. The Basilica Vaults meta event only starts when the events: {{event|Help Explorer Dhexx decipher the relics}} and {{event|Survive the trap room}} are completed. == Objectives == * Coalesced Magic
{{event bar empty}} [[File:Coalesced Magic icon.png|20 px]] * Your contribution: x * Time to turn in objective: 0:xx (when event bar is full) * Elite/Champion Enchanted Staff/Sword/Torch
{{event bar}} {{event boss}} == Rewards == {{section-stub|event|Bonus chest}} {{Event rewards}} * One Event Bouncy Chest: ** {{rewards item|Antiquated Ducats|qty=25}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Unidentified Gear|qty=3|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|qty=1|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Drip of Liquid Karma|chance=chance}} * {{rewards item|Starlit Weald Renown Token|qty=1}} == Walkthrough == * Kill enchanted weapons which will drop [[Coalesced Magic]]. * Gather Coalesced Magic and hand it to Isgarren until the progress bar is full. * A powerful enchanted weapon will spawn at 50% progress, which also has to be defeated to complete the event. * Keep an eye on Isgarren's hp bar as he can be hurt by foes. === Skills === {| {{STDT|pve}} {{Environmental skill table header}} {{Environmental skill table row|Rush (rabbit icon)}} |} == NPCs == === Allies === * [[Isgarren]] === Foes === * [[Enchanted Staff]] * [[Enchanted Sword]] * [[Enchanted Torch]] * One of the following: ** [[Elite Enchanted Torch]] *** [[Champion Enchanted Torch]] {{upscaled}} ** [[Elite Enchanted Staff]] *** [[Champion Enchanted Staff]] {{upscaled}} ** [[Elite Enchanted Sword]] *** [[Champion Enchanted Sword]] {{upscaled}} == Objects == * {{event icon|gather}} [[Coalesced Magic]] == Dialogue == ;Event start :'''Isgarren:''' ''Ah, this is not expected. But it can be turned to our advantage.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''The doors can be powered by the same source as these defenses.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Do I really need to connect the dots for you?'' ;At 50% magic collected and the powerful enchanted weapon appears :'''Isgarren:''' ''Insistent indeed.'' :'''Isgarren:''' ''Dispense with it so we can continue.'' ;At 100% magic collected :'''Isgarren:''' ''Begone!'' :''(Isgarren applies [[fear]] to all constructs around him.)'' ;Event success :'''Isgarren:''' ''A capable effort.
